feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 29 June 2026 4:42am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Monday, 29 June 2026 at 4:40am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

Low to the southeast of Iceland, moving northwards. Mid-Atlantic low moving northeast, with associated weather fronts affecting the British Isles tonight and tomorrow.


##Wind##

West or southwest 4 or 5, backing south or southwest 4 occasionally 5 later this morning and afternoon. Increasing more generally southerly 5 in central and western parts of the area later this afternoon and evening. Decreasing 3 or 4 for a while late evening & early tonight, then becoming south to southeast 4 or 5 overnight.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Mostly fair, then periods of rain and drizzle spreading from the west later this evening and overnight.


##Visibility##

Generally good today, becoming mostly moderate or poor tonight.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South to southeast 4 or 5, imminently increasing 5 or 6 in the west of the area. Easing south or southwest 3 or 4, occasional 5, in all waters during Tuesday afternoon. Then veering west or northwest later in the period.


##State of Sea##

Mostly moderate in the west of the area at first, slight or moderate elsewhere, becoming mostly slight in all parts later on Tuesday.


##Weather##

Periods of rain and drizzle, becoming mostly fair in the afternoon.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in the rain and drizzle.
